title: P374,000 'shabu,' gun seized in Mabalacat City

blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY, Pampanga — Police arrested two suspected drug pushers who allegedly yielded P374,000 worth of shabu (crystal methamphetamine) and a gun in a buy-bust operation in Barangay Dau on Friday night, Oct. 9. In a statement, the Pampanga police said the sting operation took place at Purok Balaba Phase 2 at 9:43 p.m. The two suspects, identified by police as “high-value individuals” on the law enforcement agency’s list of drug personalities, were arrested after allegedly selling a sachet of shabu to an undercover operative in exchange for marked money.
